convention.he: 1-based OSHB token index `w` within the verse
convention.es: 0-based LBF Spanish word indices within the verse
convention.invariant: every Hebrew token appears in >=1 row; every Spanish word appears in >=1 row
convention.sharing: a Spanish word may be claimed by more than one Hebrew token (construct chains, object markers, ketiv/qere); a Hebrew token may map to discontinuous Spanish indices where word order differs
